name: pi-for-vscode
description: A webview interface for Pi Coding Agent in VS Code.

commands.title: Pi for VS Code: New Session
Pi for VS Code: Reinstall/Repair Bundled Pi Agent

pi-for-vscode.piPath.description: Path to the pi CLI executable. Leave as "pi" to auto-detect on PATH; set an absolute path to force a specific install.

enumDescriptions: Use the pi found via piPath/PATH if present; otherwise fall back to the bundled agent.
Always use the bundled agent, ignoring any pi on PATH.
Never use the bundled agent; require pi on PATH or via piPath.
pi-for-vscode.useBundledPi.description: Controls when the agent bundled with this extension is used.

pi-for-vscode.extraArgs.description: Extra CLI arguments passed to pi after --mode rpc.

pi-for-vscode.persistSessions.description: Persist Pi sessions using Pi's normal session storage. Disable to pass --no-session.

pi-for-vscode.defaultStreamingBehavior.description: How a message sent while Pi is already working is delivered: "steer" injects it into the running task before the next model call (interject); "followUp" queues it to be answered after the current task finishes.

pi-for-vscode.openOnStartup.description: Force-open the Pi webview when VS Code starts. Off by default: VS Code restores whatever panel you last had open (Pi included), so forcing Pi steals focus from other views.

pi-for-vscode.brokerIdleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes the detached Pi background broker stays alive after VS Code disconnects. Set to 0 to stop immediately when idle.

pi-for-vscode.prewarmSession.description: Keep one spare Pi process booted in the background so opening a new session (or sending the first message) is instant instead of waiting for a cold start. Costs one extra idle process per window; disable on low-memory machines.

pi-for-vscode.bundle.todo.description: Load the bundled todo extension so Pi can track task lists. Skipped automatically if you have already registered this same package (@juicesharp/rpiv-todo) in your own pi — e.g. via `pi package add` or another Pi UI's marketplace. Disable to keep it out of the system prompt.

pi-for-vscode.bundle.web.description: Load the bundled web-access extension so Pi can search the web and fetch URLs. Skipped automatically if you have already registered this same package (pi-web-access) in your own pi — e.g. via `pi package add` or another Pi UI's marketplace. Disable to keep it out of the system prompt.

scripts.lint: tsc -p ./ --noEmit && tsc -p src/webview && tsc -p test --noEmit && npm run lint:size
